en.title: Virginia governor declares state of emergency after coastal storm
en.dek: Gov. Spanberger declared a state of emergency following a Thanksgiving storm according to WSLS and FOX 5 DC.
facts: Governor Spanberger declared a state of emergency following a Thanksgiving storm
The declaration followed reports of coastal storm impacts in Virginia
Multiple outlets confirmed the emergency declaration on November 27, 2026

body: Governor Abigail Spanberger declared a state of emergency following a Thanksgiving storm according to WSLS and FOX 5 DC.
The declaration came after a coastal storm affected Virginia during the Thanksgiving period.
Both WSLS and FOX 5 DC reported on Governor Spanberger's emergency action.
The state of emergency declaration was made public on November 27, 2026.
WJLA and Washington Examiner confirmed Governor Spanberger's emergency declaration following a severe coastal storm.

The state of emergency was declared in response to storm impacts during the Thanksgiving holiday period.

en.headline: State of emergency declared after Thanksgiving nor'easter
en.body: Governor Spanberger has declared a state of emergency following a severe coastal storm. WJLA and Washington Examiner confirm the emergency declaration.

fr.headline: État d'urgence déclaré après le nor'easter de Thanksgiving
fr.body: Le gouverneur Spanberger a déclaré l'état d'urgence suite à une violente tempête côtière. WJLA et Washington Examiner confirment la déclaration d'urgence.

de.headline: Notstand nach Thanksgiving-Nor'easter ausgerufen
de.body: Regierungspräsident Spanberger hat nach einem schweren Küstensturm den Notstand ausgerufen. WJLA und Washington Examiner bestätigen die Notstandsverkündung.

it.headline: Stato di emergenza dopo la tempesta da nord-est del Giorno del Ringraziamento
it.body: Il governatore Spanberger ha dichiarato lo stato di emergenza in seguito a una violenta tempesta costiera. WJLA e Washington Examiner confermano la dichiarazione di emergenza.

zh.headline: 感恩节东北风暴后宣布进入紧急状态
zh.body: 斯潘伯格州长在一场严重的沿海风暴过后宣布进入紧急状态。WJLA和《华盛顿观察家报》证实了这一紧急状态声明。

pt.headline: Estado de emergência declarado após nor'easter do Dia de Ação de Graças
pt.body: A governadora Spanberger declarou o estado de emergência na sequência de uma severa tempestade costeira. A WJLA e o Washington Examiner confirmam a declaração de emergência.

es.headline: Declarado el estado de emergencia tras el nor'easter del Día de Acción de Gracias
es.body: La gobernadora Spanberger ha declarado el estado de emergencia tras una severa tormenta costera. WJLA y Washington Examiner confirman la declaración de emergencia.

ja.headline: 感謝祭のノーイースターを受け非常事態宣言
ja.body: スパンバーガー州知事は、激しい沿岸暴風雨を受けて非常事態を宣言した。WJLAとワシントン・エグザミナーが、この非常事態宣言を確認している。

ko.headline: 추수감사절 노스이스터 이후 비상사태 선포
ko.body: 스팬버거 주지사가 심각한 연안 폭풍 이후 비상사태를 선포했다. WJLA와 워싱턴 이그재미너가 이번 비상사태 선포를 확인했다.
